data.summary:
Results-oriented Payments Business Analyst with over 7 years of total work experience. Proven expertise in analysing, designing, 
and optimizing payment schemes and workflows across several EMEA countries and SWIFT. Strong background in CBPR, SWIFT, 
regulatory compliance (PSD2, GDPR), payments standards (ISO 20022, SWIFT MT) and payment related technologies (Volante). 
Skilled in functional specifications, troubleshooting, cross-border payments, RTGS and ACH payments, and Agile delivery. Adept 
at collaborating across architecture, engineering, and program teams to deliver robust payment transformation solutions.

responsibilities: Managed end-to-end project coordination for SWIFT MT to ISO20022 payment transformation projects, overseeing delivery timelines, risk tracking, and cross-functional team alignment across BA, development, QA, and infrastructure teams.
Led end-to-end business analysis for the migration of a global bank’s legacy MT based payment system to ISO20022, improving STP rate by 22%.
Created comprehensive functional specifications and integration designs using ISO 20022 for multiple payment channels.
Acted as liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring traceability from business objectives to technical deliverables.

Led project governance and stakeholder management activities including project reviews, status reporting, RAID tracking, dependency management, and executive-level updates for multiple domestic and cross-border payment workstreams.

Coordinated release management and implementation planning for critical payment system deployments, driving cutover readiness, environment synchronization, defect triaging, rollback planning, and post-production stabilization activities.

Worked closely with business team, solution architects, and client stakeholders to manage project deliverables, prioritize payment enhancement initiatives, track resource dependencies, and ensure successful delivery within Agile project timelines.
Developed business cases and process maps for transforming manual reconciliation process into an automated flow, reducing processing time by 25%.
Conducted business process assessments for mid-sized clients adopting Volante, focusing on UK domestic payment integration.
Designed and maintained Business requirement documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs) and Interface Control Documents (ICDs) for SEPA payments.
Reviewed and implemented data privacy and security recommendations to meet GDPR requirements during onboarding and transaction processing.
Drafted user stories and contributed to sprint planning and backlog grooming in Agile environment for payment system enhancement initiatives of several EMEA based countries.
Identified and resolved production issues in Volante-based translation services due to malformed SWIFT MT messages.
Worked closely with Volante product integration teams to map legacy payment interfaces to the modified payment messaging system, ensuring zero data loss and incorporating sanctions screening.
Defined and documented asynchronous messaging requirements using IBM MQ for payment processing, including queue structures, message flows and integration with Volpay.

Gathered and documented API requirements for payment services (initiation, validation, status tracking), including endpoint definitions, request/response schemas (JSON/XML), and mapping with ISO 20022/MT message formats.
Designed and documented cross-border payment flows using SWIFT MT and ISO MX formats involving correspondent banking setups.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies, wrote user stories, and collaborated with QA to define UAT scenarios for domestic and international payment journeys.
Detected a bottleneck in payment authorization flow of a EMEA country due to outdated compliance rule triggers; recommended and implemented a rule update, reducing transaction drop rate by 15%.
Led the centralized Production dashboard integration project – aligned workflows with compliance standards.
Involved in requirement gathering, coordinating with the stakeholders, user story writing and UA testing in the above projects.
Acted as a bridge between product, technology, and customer service teams, leading to a faster feedback loop and agile improvements.
Real-time Troubleshooting: During a system rollout, proactively identified a data sync issue affecting user authentication.
Collaborated with developers and DBAs to implement a patch within 24 hours, minimizing user impact.

Infosys Limited; Pune, Maharashtra
Business Analyst
Sep 2020 – Present
Managed end-to-end project coordination for SWIFT MT to ISO20022 payment transformation projects, overseeing delivery
timelines, risk tracking, and cross-functional team alignment across BA, development, QA, and infrastructure teams. Led end-to-end business analysis for the migration of a global bank’s legacy MT based payment system to ISO20022, improving STP rate by 22%.
Created comprehensive functional specifications and integration designs using ISO 20022 for multiple payment channels.
Acted as liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring traceability from business objectives to technical
deliverables. Led project governance and stakeholder management activities including project reviews, status reporting, RAID tracking, dependency management, and executive-level updates for multiple domestic and cross-border payment workstreams. Coordinated release management and implementation planning for critical payment system deployments, driving cutover readiness, environment synchronization, defect triaging, rollback planning, and post-production stabilization activities. Collaborated with the architecture team to document non-functional requirements including scalability and resiliency for real- time payment processing.
Worked closely with business team, solution architects, and client stakeholders to manage project deliverables, prioritize payment enhancement initiatives, track resource dependencies, and ensure successful delivery within Agile project timelines.
Developed business cases and process maps for transforming manual reconciliation process into an automated flow, reducing processing time by 25%.
Conducted business process assessments for mid-sized clients adopting Volante, focusing on UK domestic payment integration.
Designed and maintained Business requirement documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs) and Interface
Control Documents (ICDs) for SEPA payments. Reviewed and implemented data privacy and security recommendations to meet GDPR requirements during onboarding and transaction processing.
Drafted user stories and contributed to sprint planning and backlog grooming in Agile environment for payment system enhancement initiatives of several EMEA based countries.
Identified and resolved production issues in Volante-based translation services due to malformed SWIFT MT messages.
Worked closely with Volante product integration teams to map legacy payment interfaces to the modified payment messaging
system, ensuring zero data loss and incorporating sanctions screening.
Defined and documented asynchronous messaging requirements using IBM MQ for payment processing, including queue
structures, message flows and integration with Volpay.
Gathered and documented API requirements for payment services (initiation, validation, status tracking), including endpoint definitions, request/response schemas (JSON/XML), and mapping with ISO 20022/MT message formats.
Designed and documented cross-border payment flows using SWIFT MT and ISO MX formats involving correspondent banking
setups. Facilitated Agile ceremonies, wrote user stories, and collaborated with QA to define UAT scenarios for domestic and international payment journeys.
Detected a bottleneck in payment authorization flow of a EMEA country due to outdated compliance rule triggers; recommended and implemented a rule update, reducing transaction drop rate by 15%.
